messages:
Iris (Finance): Heads-up: renewal for invoice 9053 (NovusCare) just failed - card declined by acquirer.
Kai (Payments): Decline code?
Iris (Finance): gateway shows: code=92; acquirer_msg=refer_to_issuer; avs=partial; 3ds_status=challenge_required
Jo (Support): Customer says they tried retrying via app, same result. They're asking for immediate alternative payment.
Kai (Payments): 92 usually needs issuer contact; also 3DS not completed. Suggest two paths: wire or re-add card via desktop to complete 3DS.
Iris (Finance): Wire OK? Invoice = $6,450. Any limits?
Kai (Payments): Wires allowed. I'll flag invoice to pause auto-retries.
Jo (Support): Messaging customer: "We can send wire instructions or try re-adding card on desktop for 3DS. Reply 'WIRE' if you want bank details."
LedgerBot: followup reminder set for invoice 9053 in 48h
Jo (Support): Customer replied 'WIRE'. Forwarding to finance.
Iris (Finance): Nora from accounting will send wire info and request bank confirmation. Kai, keep retries paused until we mark paid.
Kai (Payments): Got it, pausing retries and will match incoming wire to invoice ref.
